about: What each ADI stage runs. Launch caps live in stages.json (same stage names). Nothing machine-specific is stored here; the artifact venv comes from --artifact-root / AUDITOR_ARTIFACTS_ROOT.

artifact_ref.paper: Choi et al., Agent Data Injection Attacks are Realistic Threats to AI Agents, arXiv:2607.05120v1

sources.max_retries: artifact default: ChatOpenAI(max_retries=None) -> openai SDK default 2 (agents/baseline/graph.py:124-125)
sources.timeout: above the guard's 120 s upstream timeout so a slow request is not retried while still billable

benchmark.d1_rule: every suite is named with -s; with no -s the artifact imports mistralai and crashes (NOTES.md D1)

DRY.purpose: plumbing dry run through the guard to local Ollama qwen2.5:7b-instruct; not a measurement

S1.purpose: 3 authority ADI cases (send_money recipient, DM recipient, calendar event id); checks DeepSeek accepts the wire and calibrates tokens per episode

S2.purpose: all 108 data_only_syntactic cases, then all 96 benign user tasks: DeepSeek ADI ASR, utility under attack, benign utility

estimates.status: UNVERIFIED; tokens are prompt + completion; recalibrate S2 from the S1 ledger

price_snapshot.status: UNVERIFIED on 2026-10-08; cache-miss input price applied to every prompt token (upper bound)

lab_native_deepseek_tokens_per_slot.source: packages/agentdojo-lab/configs/pilot_protocol_v1_draft.json budget.measured_per_slot.native (252 DeepSeek native AgentDojo slots, 1,024 requests, 13,825 tokens per slot)
lab_native_deepseek_tokens_per_slot.caveat: vendored AgentDojo pipeline with YAML tool output; ADI runs LangGraph with JSON tool output, so this is the low basis

adi_ground_truth_proxy.source: <ADI_ARTIFACT_ROOT>/smoke/adi_token_estimate.json: ground-truth trajectories, request context chars/4 and chars/3, divided per episode

fidelity.mode: backbone-substituted fidelity check: deepseek-flash (thinking disabled, T=0) replaces GPT-5.2-2025-12-11; not an exact reproduction

published_target.source: arXiv:2607.05120v1 Fig. 9-10, section 6.2.2, pp.12-13 (as recorded in <ADI_ARTIFACT_ROOT>/NOTES.md section 6)

fidelity.comparison_rule: report DeepSeek k/n with Wilson 95% beside the target; a different backbone has no pass/fail band. The plumbing passes when every planned episode has utility and security set and error-scored episodes are listed.

deviations_from_artifact_cli: model: deepseek-flash is registered at runtime (MODEL_NAMES entry + baseline _get_model_instance patch); the artifact's ModelsEnum/click choice is bypassed by calling scripts.benchmark.benchmark_suite directly
wire: max_tokens=2048 and thinking disabled are added (the artifact sends no output limit); the guard drops parallel_tool_calls=true, which the baseline binds
temperature 0 is actually sent (langchain-openai drops temperature only for gpt-5* models)
one benchmark_suite call per (pass, suite, user task) instead of one per suite; scoring code is unchanged
load_dotenv('.env') is replaced by a no-op; provider and tracing variables are removed
